language.onboardingDescription: You can change this at any time from the sidebar.

library.emptyStateText: Import your conversation export files to store them in this browser and keep them available offline.
library.quotaWarning: Browser storage is almost full. To keep future conversations saving, delete a few older conversations.

dialogs.deleteDescription: “{{label}}” will be permanently removed from this browser's library and cannot be restored. The original file on your device is unchanged.
dialogs.clearAllDescription: Every conversation will be permanently removed from this browser's library. This cannot be undone; the original files on your device are unchanged.

import.pageSubheading: All processing happens on this device and no data is sent to the internet.
import.mismatch: The selected file belongs to {{actual}}, not {{expected}}.
import.allDuplicates: Every conversation is a duplicate, so nothing will be added.
import.dropzoneHint: Drop a JSON file here, or choose one with the button below.
import.comingSoonNotice: Import for this platform is coming soon.
import.largeFileWarning: The file <file>{{name}}</file> is {{size}} and processing it may take a while. Continue?

errors.FileReadError: This file could not be read. Please try again.
errors.MalformedJsonError: This file cannot be read. Please use the platform's own export.
errors.EmptyContentError: This file is empty and has no content to display.
errors.UnsupportedFormatError: This file does not belong to any supported platform (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek).
errors.AmbiguousFormatError: The file format cannot be determined with certainty.
errors.MissingFieldError: This file's structure is incomplete, so its conversations could not be read.
errors.UnexpectedTypeError: This file's structure does not match what was expected.
errors.UnexpectedImportError: Something went wrong while processing this file. If it is very large, please try again.
errors.StorageQuotaError: Browser storage is full. To add a new conversation, delete a few older ones.
errors.StorageWriteError: This conversation could not be saved. Your library is unchanged.
errors.StorageReadError: Your conversation library could not be read. Please reload the page.
errors.StorageDeleteError: This conversation could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.InvalidConversationError: This conversation's structure is incomplete, so it could not be saved.

themes.emptyConversation: There are no messages to show in this conversation.
